description:
A XUL-based web-browser built on top of the Unified XUL Platform (UXP). This browser is a close twin to pre-Servo Firefox in how it operates.

Basilisk is a free and Open Source XUL-based web browser, featuring the well-known Firefox-style interface and operation. It is based on the Goanna layout and rendering engine (a fork of Gecko) and builds on the Unified XUL Platform (UXP), which in turn is a fork of the Mozilla code base without Servo or Rust.
UXP Changes:
- Removed compromised eMudhra certificates from the certificate store.
- Updated SQLite to 3.54.1.
- Updated the executable extensions list to warn about additional types of files.
- Fixed several potential application crashes.
- Restricted JAR loading to align better with in-browser usage.
- Fixed an issue with potential out-of-bounds access in JavaScript.
- Disabled the new :has() CSS implementation by default for performance reasons. See implementation notes.
- Added a preference for handling improper form element placement in HTML. See implementation notes.
- Backported an upstream libvpx VP8 decoder fix.
- Fixed an issue in the BigInt implementation that caused specific JavaScript calls to fail.
- Fixed a potentially exploitable memory leak.
- Security issues addressed: CVE-2026-109730 (DiD), CVE-2026-109735, CVE-2026-109736, CVE-2026-109782, CVE-2026-109763, CVE-2026-109776 (DiD), CVE-2026-100822, CVE-2026-100783, CVE-2026-100773 (DiD), CVE-2026-96869 (DiD), CVE-2026-100791, and several others that did not have a CVE designation at the time of evaluation.

Basilisk Changes:
- Introduced Intel 32-bit macOS builds for OS X 10.6 and later. These builds do not support automatic updates.
- Enabled automatic updates for MIPS64EL Linux builds.
- Built on UXP commit: 6b18be917d

Included Polyfills:
- This release includes the following polyfills:
  - image.decode
  - Intl.DisplayNames
  - Intl.RelativeTimeFormat
  - Intl.Segmenter
  - en-US only Intl.ListFormat
  - Microsoft-specific (Outlook, Azure, etc) webauthn shim
  - TextDecoderStream
  - TextEncoderStream
  - TransformStream
  - ReadableStream pipeTo
  - ReadableStream pipeThrough
  - getAnimations
  - elementFromPoint finite values

UXP Implementation Notes:
- The CSS :has() pseudo-class selector was disabled by default because it caused severe performance issues on websites. This reduces web compatibility for some sites, but should improve browser performance while the root cause is investigated. The feature is expected to be enabled again after the performance issues have been addressed.
- If you do not mind the performance impact or have fast hardware, you can enable the feature by setting layout.css.has-pseudo.enabled to true for broader website compatibility at the cost of additional processing.
- Form elements in HTML documents has been tightened for security reasons to adhere more strictly to the HTML standard regarding forms in tables. You can now control this with the preference html5.forms.standards_compliant. By default, this is set to true to adhere to the specification, but you can temporarily set it to false and reload the page to allow more lax parsing of forms similar to earlier versions of Basilisk.
